headline: Binance says North Korea-linked hackers stole billions in historic crypto heist
summary: Binance lost an estimated $6.3 billion in a historic crypto heist blamed on North Korean hackers, who reportedly used a fake job interview and malware to compromise an engineer's laptop. The exchange froze transactions, pledged to cover customer losses, and later said it had restored most of the stolen funds. The FBI attributed the attack to North Korea, which denied responsibility, while reported dollar figures varied across coverage from $5.6 billion to $6.34 billion.
